title: Junior Game Developer
description: Entry-level game developer position focused on foundational engine proficiency, core programming, game math, basic design skills, and version control. Expected to implement gameplay features, create simple game systems, and contribute to a team under guidance.

skills.rationale: Engine proficiency is the foundation; daily scene, physics, and animation work is non-negotiable
Daily coding in C#, C++, or GDScript; OOP patterns and data structures are essential
Vectors, transforms, and trigonometry are used daily for gameplay mechanics
Understanding mechanics design and prototyping is expected for implementing gameplay
Git fundamentals and branching are expected from day one in any team environment
Basic FSMs and steering behaviors for simple NPC gameplay systems
Awareness of frame budget and basic profiler usage; not expected to deep-optimize
Shader basics and material understanding; deep graphics is mid-level territory
Aspirational for juniors; understanding client-server concepts is enough

scoring.description: Each skill score is multiplied by its importance weight. Final score is the sum of weighted scores divided by sum of weights.
